sections.title: A new case suffix
sections.content: -nál/-nél means "at" a person or place — chosen by vowel harmony, the same pair you've used for every suffix so far. Add it to a name or a possessed family noun to say whose place you're at.

items.english: Today I'm at his/her parents' place.
On Sunday we're at Anna's place.

sections.content: You already met this suffix in passing — fogorvosnál ("at the dentist's") back in Unit 2 — this is the lesson that gives it its own name and its own rule.
